payload.name: SearchGroupEventMemoriesForOtherFriends
payload.description: When a question asks whether a person has friends, teammates, or social connections besides/apart from a named person, include event and group-participation memories; do not restrict to relationship memories or the word 'friend'.
content: When a question asks whether someone has friends or social connections besides, apart from, or other than a named person, do not restrict retrieval to memory_kind 'relationship' or to queries containing only 'friend'.

Run at least one search over event (and optionally profile/relationship) memories using group-participation terms (team, teammate, club, tournament, group, class, colleague, coworker) with the subject's name, and omit the named excluded person from the query and keywords.

If initial results only describe the named relationship, broaden memory_kinds and re-query with additional group/activity expansions before concluding the person has no other friends; event memories of team or group participation can imply other social connections.

solves: The Access Agent answered 'no friends besides X' after restricting searches to relationship memories and the word 'friend', missing an event memory implying teammates. Abstractly, questions about a person's social circle beyond a named person require event/group-participation evidence, not just relationship memories. Future 'besides/apart from' friendship questions should trigger broader memory-kind searches; activity-enumeration questions are outside this skill.
